dedupe_keys.name: dam in comprehensive dam catchment attributes for dam safety studies in india

description: DAM-IN: Comprehensive Dam Catchment Attributes for Dam Safety Studies in India is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Mayank Tiwari et al. The Indian subcontinent has around 5715 dams across different rivers, which support various economic sectors in the country. In this study, we developed a dataset of catchment attributes for 5715 dams over the Indian subcontinent using observed, reanalysis, and remote sensing data. Coverage: national (IN); published in 2025. Formats: Excel, ZIP. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
